{{Quote|We must train warriors, then find and destroy the gundark nest.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=GundarkDestruction.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predatory [[Species/Legends|species]], had a '''nest''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], the nest was [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attacked]] by the forces of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] and a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], who were both attempting to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonize]] the moon. The nest was destroyed, and the gundarks became extinct on Alaris Prime.

==Description==
A nest was created on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] by the [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators.<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> The nest was built in a small clearing in one of Alaris Prime's [[Tree/Legends|forests]] and could be reached by crossing a shallow [[Water/Legends|river]]. Most of the ground in the area was covered in dirt. Several gundark corpses inhabited the nest.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Trade Federation battle droids! They're wiping out the gundarks!|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TU3-WNARN-L64.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> two groups&mdash;the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and members of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species&mdash;attempted to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonize]] Alaris Prime. Both of these parties were attacked by the gundarks, resulting in the factions deciding to [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|assault]] the nest and [[Death/Legends|destroy]] them.<ref name="SW:GB" />

[[File:Tutorial_3_Droids_at_the_nest.png|thumb|right|250px|The nest under attack by the Trade Federation]]
On advice from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to oversee their colonization effort, the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]], under the leadership of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], trained [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] at a nearby [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|base]] to attack the gundarks. The Trade Federation also sent a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s from its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|army]] to destroy the nest. The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] arrived there first and began attacking the gundarks. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, the Wookiees reached the nest, killing two gundarks that they encountered nearby. Upon killing all of the gundarks at the nest, one of the battle droids ordered its comrades to open fire on the Wookiee warriors; however, they fought back and destroyed all of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The nest was destroyed in the attack, and gundarks became an extinct species on Alaris Prime.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gundark nest first appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The nest appears in the third level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Building an Army," where the player uses the Wookiees and must train soldiers to attack the gundarks.<ref name="SW:GB" />
